statement: Paired long/short desks run by one actor, scored jointly (gap15pct_cap1500): pool net result after principal loss, fees and profit share
methodology: Perpl bytecode harness; move 1500 bps in 1 step(s); desk notional cap 1500.00 AUSD; principal loss 80.82; actor net extraction 56.40. A measured scenario, not a universal bound.
